# Installation

Install it with <Highlight>your package manager</Highlight>.

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="npm" label="npm">

```bash
npm install acme
```

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="yarn" label="Yarn" attributes={{className: "tab-yarn"}}>

```bash
yarn add acme
```

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::tip[Pro tip]

Pin the version in CI.
